item.title: Bulletin updated at 06:50 HKT 18/Jan/2023
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
The dry winter monsoon will bring mainly fine weather to Guangdong in the next couple of days. The temperature difference between day and night will be relatively large. It will still be cold over the region this morning. An easterly airstream is expected to affect the coastal areas on Lunar New Year's Eve and Lunar New Year's Day. It will be cloudier over the region. Another surge of the northeast monsoon will reach the coast of southern China on the second day of the Lunar New Year. Temperatures will fall again over the region.
